description: Patch modifies an extra file (README.md) not in the expected files list.
patch:
diff --git a/src/calculator.py b/src/calculator.py
index abc1234..def5678 100644
--- a/src/calculator.py
+++ b/src/calculator.py
@@ -12,3 +12,5 @@ def divide(a, b):
-    return a / b
+    if b == 0:
+        raise ValueError()
+    return a / b
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index abc1234..def5678 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1 @@
-# Calculator
+# Calculator (modified)
